purpose: Ilustración conceptual sobre selección de una muestra de clientes para decisiones administrativas; no representa observaciones ni datos empíricos.
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: small editorial illustration for an A3 Spanish academic infographic on sampling for administrative decisions. Primary request: create a polished horizontal conceptual illustration about selecting a representative sample from a diverse business population. Scene: an administrative analyst seated at a desk examining a magnifying glass and a neat tray of distinct customer cards selected from a larger organized field of customer cards, visually implying sampling across several groups. Style: refined isometric editorial illustration, restrained professional academic appearance, clean white background, crisp edges, subtle depth, generous breathing room, suitable at 12 cm by 4 cm. Palette: deep red, muted teal, charcoal and soft gray, harmonious with ITESCA academic reports. Accurate meaning: selected cards must visibly come from several groups; do not imply that simply a large sample removes bias. No actual statistics or chart, no numerals, no written text, no logos, no watermark, no institutional seal. This is a conceptual illustration, not empirical evidence. Wide landscape composition, all meaningful objects fully contained within frame.
